scope: stack scan for client-side return addresses in the blocked client
tool: tools/client_eip.py --stack (reads the 4 KB page at each thread ESP and reports dwords that point into the client module)

notable_hits.others: 0xc40005/0xc00030/0x1c00012 style values, i.e. data words that merely fall in the module range

assessment: the scan works but most hits are data; the clearest code candidate is 0x41ea00 on tid 32092. Identifying the actual main thread still needs a discriminator (creation order, start address, or window ownership).
next: add a --main option that picks the thread whose EIP/wait is reached through a client return address, or use GetThreadId of the window owner (GetWindowThreadProcessId)
disassemble the confirmed return addresses to find the wait caller
then supply the missing signal or patch the wait
